summary: The StudentEOrientation document contains functionality for managing student orientation sessions within a web application. It includes logic for displaying course information, handling retakes of courses, and generating certificates of completion.
purpose: To provide an interface for managing student orientations, including the ability to retake courses and print certificates.
business_rules: Only allow retake if corresponding PR is not ended
Certificate is visible only when course is completed
system_behavior: Show retake button if conditions are met
exceptions: Cancel data selection if UserSession is null
